sections.heading: Pacific Engagement stream visa (PEV) Country Ballot Status
sections.text:
The Pacific Engagement stream visa (PEV) ballot for Pacific island and Timor-Leste nationals opened on 1 July 2026 and closed on 29 July 2026.

Countries participating in the PEV ballot include:

- Federated States of Micronesia
- Fiji
- Kiribati
- Palau
- Papua New Guinea
- Republic of Marshall Islands
- Samoa
- Solomon Islands
- Timor-Leste
- Tonga
- Tuvalu

- Vanuatu.

The Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade publish PEV allocations for each participating country on their web page
Pacific engagement visa.

The PEV Country Ballot Status table below provides details of each ballot. This includes the open and close period for submitting a registration and the status of each ballot.

The ballot selection process will be conducted during the selection period as outlined in the PEV Selection Period table below.

The ballot status may show as follows:

PENDING – The Ballot is pending commencement or opening.

Active – The Ballot is
open and you can submit your registration.

CLOSED – The Ballot period for participants to submit registrations is
closed. No further registrations can be submitted and the selection process is pending for this ballot.

EXPIRED – Selections have been finalised for this Ballot. No further selections will be made from this ballot.

sections.heading: Pacific Engagement stream visa (PEV) Country Ballot Status > Ballot Selection Period
sections.text:
The ballot selection process will begin after the ballot registration period is closed.

The table below shows the ballot selection period (open and close dates) for when the random selection of registrations will occur for each participating country ballot.

If we select you in the ballot you will receive an email with instructions on how to apply for a visa. Your status in ImmiAccount will show as ‘Selected’. If you are not selected in a ballot your status in ImmiAccount may show as ‘Received’ for the current program year or ‘Expired’ for a previous program year.

Selected participants have 120 days from the date of notification of selection to complete their visa application and submit it online.

For more information see
After you register.

Further details for the next PEV ballot period will be published on the department’s website.
